title: Gradient Button Animation
description: Beautiful gradient animation on hover with smooth color transitions. Perfect for call-to-action buttons and interactive elements.

title: Typography Pairing: Playfair & Inter
description: Elegant serif and sans-serif combination. Playfair Display for headlines with Inter for body text creates a perfect balance of personality and readability.

title: Ocean Color Palette
description: Calming ocean-inspired color scheme with deep blues, aqua greens, and sandy neutrals. Perfect for wellness and nature-focused applications.

title: Playful Character Illustration Style
description: Bold, friendly character design with simple shapes and vibrant colors. Great reference for approachable brand illustrations.

title: Clean Dashboard Layout
description: Modern dashboard design with excellent visual hierarchy, clear data visualization, and intuitive navigation. Notice the effective use of whitespace and card-based layout.
